description: Meitei Language Library Digital Book Catalog

books.title: ꯈꯝꯕ ꯊꯣꯏꯕꯤ
books.title_en: Khamba Thoibi: The Epic of Moirang
books.author: Hijam Anganghal Singh (adapted from ancient Moirang Kangleirol oral folklore)
books.description: The national epic of the Meitei people chronicling the legendary love, chivalric trials, and spiritual heroism of orphan youth Khuman Khamba and princess Thoibi of Moirang.
books.source: Moirang Kangleirol Epic Cycles & Manipuri Sahitya Parishad Folklore Archives
books.copyright: Public Domain (Traditional Meitei Epic Folklore and Oral Heritage)

books.title: ꯃꯩꯇꯩ ꯐꯨꯡꯒꯥ ꯋꯥꯔꯤ
books.title_en: Meitei Phunga Wari: Hearth-Side Folktales of Manipur
books.author: Traditional Folklorists (Oral Heritage of Manipur)
books.description: Beloved oral folktales recited around the traditional domestic hearth (Phunga Lairu) during winter evenings across Meitei homes, including Pebet and Tapta.
books.source: Directorate of Language Planning & Manipuri Folklore Heritage Society

books.title: ꯁꯅꯥ ꯂꯩꯕꯥꯛ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔ ꯄꯨꯋꯥꯔꯤ
books.title_en: The Golden Land: Chronicles, Puyas and Heritage of Manipur
books.author: Court Chroniclers and Maichous of Kangleipak
books.description: Historical chronicle synthesizing sovereign heritage, Kangla coronation rituals, and royal statecraft of ancient Manipur.
books.source: Kangla Palace Historical Archives & State Archives of Manipur

books.title: ꯔꯥꯃꯥꯌꯟ
books.title_en: Ramayana: The Epic of Rama in Meitei Tradition
books.author: Angom Gopi & Classical Meitei Translators (reign of King Garibniwaz)
books.description: Classical 18th-century Meitei adaptation of the epic Ramayana translated during the religious renaissance of King Pamheiba.
books.source: Manipuri Sahitya Parishad Classical Text Archives

books.title: ꯃꯍꯥꯚꯥꯔꯠ ꯑꯃꯁꯨꯡ ꯃꯅꯤꯄꯨꯔ
books.title_en: Mahabharata: The Great Epic and the Manipur Connection
books.author: Court Pandits of Manipur (adapted from Vyasa's epic tradition)
books.description: Celebrated episodes linking the Mahabharata with ancient Manipur, including Arjuna's arrival, union with Chitrangada, and the heroism of Babruvahana.
books.source: Directorate of Art & Culture, Government of Manipur

books.title: ꯅꯨꯃꯤꯠ ꯀꯥꯞꯄ
books.title_en: Numit Kappa: The Shooting of the Sun
books.author: Ancient Meitei Bards (Maichous of Kangleipak)
books.genre: Archaic Puya / Solar Mythology & Ritual Poetry
books.description: One of the oldest documented literary and cosmological texts of the Meitei people, narrating how archer Khwai Nongchenbam heroically shot down one of two scorching suns.
books.source: National Manuscript Mission & Puya Preservation Archives

books.title: ꯆꯥꯏꯅꯔꯣꯜ
books.title_en: Chainarol: The Ancient Code of Chivalry and Warrior Duels
books.author: Ancient Maichous (Preservers of Martial Tradition)
books.description: Archaic martial puya detailing ethical duels, chivalric codes of honor, fair combat protocols, and warrior ethics in pre-colonial Manipur.
books.source: Manipur State Kala Akademi & Thang-Ta Cultural Archives

books.title: ꯄꯥꯟꯊꯣꯏꯕꯤ ꯈꯣꯡꯒꯨꯜ
books.title_en: Panthoibi Khonggul: The Trail and Glory of Goddess Panthoibi
books.author: Ancient Meitei Seers (Sanamahi Religious Lore)
books.genre: Sacred Puya / Mythological Romance & Divine Allegory
books.description: Sacred puya chronicling the fearless spirit, spiritual wanderings, and cosmic union of goddess Panthoibi and lord Nongpok Ningthou.

books.title: ꯄꯣꯏꯔꯩꯇꯣꯟ ꯈꯨꯟꯊꯣꯛ
books.title_en: Poireiton Khunthok: The Great Migration of King Poireiton
books.author: Ancient Chroniclers of the Luwang Dynasty
books.description: Ancient prose puya recording King Poireiton's pioneering civilizational migration from the netherworld Khamnung into the fertile valley of Manipur.
books.source: Manuscript Division, Manipur University Central Library

books.title: ꯄꯥꯈꯪꯕ ꯂꯥꯏꯍꯨꯏ
books.title_en: Pakhangba Laihui: The Divine Chronicle of Sovereign Pakhangba
books.author: Royal Court Priests and Pandits of Kangleipak
books.description: Sacred royal genealogy recording divine manifestations, royal coronation rituals, and cosmic origins of sovereign Ibudhou Pakhangba.
books.source: Govindaji Temple Royal Trust & Manipur State Archives
